cells.normalized_text: While Armor Charge is active: Increases Mod-Element Matching Weapon Damage. Damage Increase: 10% | 17% | 22% | 25% 3% | 4.5% | 5.5% | 6% x4 is only obtainable through Artifact or Exotic Armor.

sources.finding: Six explicit element variants share both four-tier tables and ten-second base Armor Charge decay. The fourth tier is explicitly restricted to Artifact/Exotic providers, despite abbreviated 1..4 Mods wording.

Documents the shared non-stacking weapon bonus used by Surge mods and multiple Exotics; fourth tier 25 percent PvE and 6 percent PvP. Mantle bonus can stack with empowering effects. This historical note does not establish current full Exotic trigger/lifecycle behavior.

table.tier_four: Explicit independent Artifact/Exotic provider, not an extra armor mod.

rules: Each matching element mod contributes to its own count Profile and to Armor Charge enabled/passive configuration. profile_value queries current same-holder copies; count clamps at three. Charge count controls duration, not damage tier.
Require explicit weapon_damage and matching component element damage tags. Original weapon/source element alone cannot make unrelated ability or differently-elemented damage eligible.

Each equipped copy contributes the complete table value for the summed count. The weapon_surge MAX group prevents duplicate copies or a stronger external same-element provider from multiplying the shared bonus. Independent empowering/perk stages multiply outside it.
Surge reuses the single Armor Charge decay schedule and current Time Dilation. Shots do not consume charges individually; Fonts and other passive mods do not introduce additional decay timers.

Independent higher-tier lifetime does not pause lower-tier decay. Lower benefits return only if still otherwise eligible when the higher provider ends. Synthetic timed tier-four Buffs validate this composition, not actual Exotic/Artifact trigger content.

Current on_use policy snapshots copy count, Armor Charge eligibility and the chosen bonus at attack capture. Later cost consumption, source removal or provider expiration cannot rewrite that attack; new attacks use the current state.
Physical weapon/Rampage acceptance fixture adapts only the existing Rampage modifier destination profile/group; an equality assertion protects every other proc, duration, value and lifecycle field.
open_questions: Formal mod slots, three-energy costs, total legal mod combinations, Manifest wiring, HUD and production content assembly remain incomplete. Injected mixed/fourth-copy tests prove arithmetic boundaries, not valid original loadouts.
Exact original shot/impact sampling and switching policies remain uncalibrated; on_use is a documented Chorus choice, not an established universal D2 behavior.
Golden Gun exceptions, Glaive and special weapon components, activity Surge/Overcharge, all Exotic/Artifact triggers and their exact timers still require dedicated eligibility and numerical research.

The shared empowering_damage profile is used by these weapon consumers. Existing separate Solar Scorch/Ignition and other damage profiles are not automatically linked; explicit weapon/component tags test the qualification contract without claiming those world producers already receive Surge.

Synthetic weapons use base 10, five-round magazines, a 0.15-second interval and existing calibrated projectiles. PvE/PvP follows the runtime mode; complete mixed-activity classification and full physical world save/restart remain open.
